segments.text:
V. 23.
He came and dwelt in Nazareth—(where he had dwelt before he went to Bethlehem) a Place contemptible to a Proverb. So that hereby was fulfilled what had been ſpoken in effect, by ſeveral of the Prophets (tho' by none of them in expreſs Words) He ſhall be called a Nazarene—that is, He ſhall be deſpiſed and rejected, ſhall be a Mark of public Contempt and Reproach.
